items.event: US Open final — Alexander Zverev d. Ben Shelton
items.line: Zverev won 6-3, 7-6(2), 5-7, 6-2 for his first US Open title and second major of 2026 (after the French Open), the first German man to win the US Open since Boris Becker in 1989.

items.line: Europe won back the Cup at Bernardus Golf in the Netherlands after Sunday singles, with Lottie Woad and Carlota Ciganda clinching the decisive points as the US staged a late rally that fell just short.
